name: NP
context: Nord Pool electricity market dataset with hourly electricity price and exogenous grid measurements spanning 6 years (2013-01-01 to 2018-12-24).

endo.name: price
endo.description: Day-ahead hourly electricity price in the Nord Pool market (EUR/MWh).

exo.name: grid_load_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted total grid load in MW, reflecting anticipated electricity demand across the Nord Pool system.

exo.name: wind_power_forecast
exo.description: Forecasted wind power generation in MW, capturing the expected renewable energy supply in the market.
